matching_jobs.title: Social Media Intern
matching_jobs.pay_note:
$$1,000-$4,000/mo Ether.fi is one of the fastest growing fintech companies in the world with over $10B AUM and an $8M/yr marketing budget. We are looking for a hungry, resourceful intern to lead growth on TikTok and Instagram.

You will lead daily content curation and distribution and have a meaningful say in brand image across these platforms. You will essentially be the face of EtherFi across Insta and TikTok.

Goal: Scale EtherFi to 100K+ followers across Instagram and TikTok by August 2026.
matching_jobs.desc: Lead TikTok and Instagram growth for one of the fastest growing fintechs. $8M marketing budget at your disposal.

matching_jobs.title: GTM Engineer Intern
matching_jobs.pay_note:
$$1,000-$4,000/mo Ether.fi is one of the fastest growing fintech companies in the world with over $10B AUM. We are looking for a hungry, resourceful intern to contribute to GTM efforts by automating processes and contributing to growth-oriented product development.
